audit_scope: three strongest primary-source near-misses returned by targeted searches for multi-channel, network, event-triggered, and bidirectional control-rate theorems
search_query_clusters: invariance feedback entropy decentralized networked multi-channel
data-rate theorem sensor controller actuator two channels
bidirectional communication invariance entropy control systems

sources.title: Network Entropy and Data Rates Required for Networked Control
sources.rate_coordinates: one constrained rate entering each direct-product plant subsystem; the paper assumes controller-to-actuator channels while noting an estimator-to-controller alternative
sources.asmp4_applicability_failure: the coordinates index receiving plant subsystems, not ASMP-4's sequential read and write interfaces, and the controller has perfect overall-state knowledge

sources.title: The Value of Timing Information in Event-Triggered Control
sources.near_miss_type: two rate notions for one event-triggered channel
sources.rate_coordinates: payload transmission rate R_s and payload-plus-timing access rate R_c on the same sensor-to-controller channel
sources.asmp4_applicability_failure: the controller-to-plant input is infinite-precision and delay-free rather than a separately charged port; acknowledgments may be signaled through the plant/control input

sources.title: Compositional Quantification of Invariance Feedback Entropy for Networks of Uncertain Control Systems
sources.near_miss_type: scalar network IFE bounded by a sum of subsystem IFEs
sources.rate_coordinates: one coder-to-controller IFE for the network and one of the same kind for each comparison subsystem
sources.asmp4_applicability_failure: the sum decomposes interconnected plant state subsystems, not sequential read/write transcripts, and supplies no sensor-domain selector

bounded_inference: The strongest located neighboring theorems are architecture-specific and do not select ASMP-4's read/write registries; applying any of them to the canonical target would require an additional architecture mapping and sensor-domain choice.
nonclaims: The targeted search is not exhaustive and cannot prove that no applicable theorem exists.
Search-engine coverage and query choice are not a substitute for external expert review.
The audit rejects only the applicability of these three inspected near-misses, not the wider literature.
